homepage.tagline.message: Blazing-Fast, Minimalist Modern C++23 Code Editor

feature.speed.desc.message: Sub-second cold startup, low memory footprint, and instantaneous responsiveness powered by Dear ImGui, SDL2, and OpenGL 3.3.

feature.themes.desc.message: Craft custom themes using human-friendly CSS syntax with full syntax and UI tokens, reloaded live on the fly.

feature.plugins.desc.message: Write lightweight, secure extensions in Lua 5.4 with direct access to editor commands, buffers, and status bar without recompilation.

feature.layout.desc.message: Sleek horizontal activity bar and flexible multi-panel docking workspace saved automatically across sessions.

feature.terminal.desc.message: Non-blocking interactive terminal console with dedicated input and auto-scrolling integrated directly into your workflow.

feature.lexers.desc.message: Edit 100k+ line files smoothly at 60+ FPS with stateful incremental token caching and fast native lexers.
